Sie möchten elektrische Systeme für autonome Plattformen entwickeln und verschiedene Sensoren, Nutzlasten sowie Steuerungskomponenten erfolgreich integrieren? - Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams
- Gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

 Begeisterung für innovative Technologien und die Produktion der Zukunft

 Künstliche Intelligenz

 You Are

You understand RTL and SystemVerilog not as academic concepts but as the daily language of getting chips to work. Maybe you have debugged clock domain crossings that made no sense until they did, or you have written UPF that actually held together through implementation, or you have stared down a formal proof that refused to converge.
 What sets you apart is that you can take that technical depth and use it to help someone else solve their problem. You listen well. You ask the right questions before jumping to an answer. When a customer describes a verification bottleneck or a power intent issue, you can map it to the tooling, the methodology, and the tradeoffs in real time. You do not need a script. You think on your feet, and you care about whether the solution actually works in their environment, not just in yours. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building the next generation of semiconductors, and what you know will matter every day.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Engage directly with customers in Shanghai and across the region to understand their SoC design and verification challenges and translate those into technical solutions using Synopsys tools
 Provide hands-on technical support and guidance across front-end and mid-end workflows including CDC/RDC, low-power design with UPF, gate-level simulation, VIP integration, and formal verification
